name: White-Tailed Deer
summary: Herbivorous woodland ungulate found throughout northern pine forests of Mount Kalaga and rural brushlands of Ambrosia. Can cause vehicle collisions on remote highways.
description: Populating the upland forests and agricultural pastures of northern Leonida, White-Tailed Deer graze in small herds along tree lines. During nocturnal driving on country routes, deer will dart across traffic, posing a real hazard to high-speed vehicles. Players hunting in Mount Kalaga can harvest high-grade pelts and venison.
habitat: Mount Kalaga National Park, Ambrosia agricultural outskirts

seo.title: White-Tailed Deer: Wildlife & Hunting Guide
